pricing_faq_heading: Nyabiase siwo ku ɖe asixɔxɔ ŋu
pricing_faq_q1: Ðe asixɔxɔdede le sasrãkpɔ ɖesiaɖe ŋu loo alo ɖe dɔwɔlawo ƒe zikpui ɖeka dzia?
pricing_faq_a1: Tiers siwo wota la nye kɔdzi ƒe ƒuƒoƒo ɖesiaɖe si ŋu kɔdzi kple zikpui ƒe nutrenuwo le. Alilikpo kple On-premise ma Starter, Asitsatsa, Scale, kple Platform. Ɣleti sia ɣleti ƒe xexlẽdzesi le teƒea nye Alilikpo + $150. Mode eveawo dometɔ aɖeke mezãa mita si wotsɔa sasrãkpɔ ɖesiaɖe si dzina ɖe edzi le ŋkeke siwo dzi vovo menɔa ame ŋu o dzi o.
pricing_faq_q2: Nukatae ƒe sia ƒe dzraa 20% ɖo?
pricing_faq_a2: Ƒe sia ƒe ƒe fexexe xea mɔ na ƒe si woate ŋu agblɔ ɖi na Medora. Loomline-style kɔdzi SaaS zi geɖe ɖea ƒe sia ƒe ɖoɖowo dzi kpɔtɔna abe 15 va ɖo 20% ene. Medora zãa 20% le ɣleti sia ɣleti ƒe xexlẽdzesiwo dzi ne èxe fe ƒe sia ƒe, na Cloud kple On-premise siaa (le +$150 On-premise premium megbe).
pricing_faq_q3: Ðe nudzraɖoƒewo kple dɔdamɔnu ƒe modules hã le emea?
pricing_faq_a3: Starter lɔ ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ veviwo, sasrãkpɔwo, kple dɔdaƒe ƒe dɔwɔƒe siwo me nudzraɖoƒe veviwo le ɖe eme. Asitsatsa kple dziƒo ʋua nudzraɖoƒe bliboa ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖowo, atikewo ƒe nudɔdɔ siwo do ƒome kple nudzraɖoƒe, kple kesinɔtɔwo ƒe admin ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ. Bia ɣeyiɣi si nèhiã kpeɖeŋutɔ siwo ŋu wowɔ ɖoɖo ɖo.
pricing_faq_q4: Xexeame katã ƒe vs Myanmar ƒe asiwo?
pricing_faq_a4: Zã asi ƒe tɔtrɔ si le ɖoɖoawo tame. Xexeame katã ɖe USD ɖeɖeko fia. Myanmar ɖe MMK fia le 1 USD = 5000 MMK (kple USD abe fli evelia ene). Fexexe ƒe ɣeyiɣi kple subɔsubɔ ƒe mɔnu to vovo tso asi gbɔ.
pricing_faq_a5: Cloud nye Medora: kɔdzi geɖe SaaS, asitɔtrɔ siwo dzi wokpɔna, kple gɔmedzedze kabakaba wu. On-premise zãa tiers mawo ke, siwo woda ɖe wò infrastructure dzi ne èhiã control alo residency. Infra nye tɔwò; ɣleti sia ɣleti ƒe xexlẽdzesi enye Alilikpo + $150 ɖe agbanɔamedzi ma ta.
